introduction.target_audience: Hardcore FPS players, ages 16-35, competitive gamers
introduction.game_overview: Void Arena is a fast-paced, competitive arena shooter set in the grimdark depths of space. Players engage in intense multiplayer battles across asymmetric maps using a diverse arsenal of futuristic weapons. Emphasis on skill-based movement, precise aim, and tactical positioning creates a high skill ceiling for competitive play.
introduction.unique_selling_points:
• Zero gravity combat mechanics with full 6DOF movement
• Weapon crafting system using salvaged components
• Procedurally generated tournament brackets
• Cross-platform competitive ranking
• Grimdark sci-fi aesthetic with industrial design
introduction.inspiration: Quake III Arena, Unreal Tournament, Titanfall 2 movement system, Warhammer 40K aesthetic, Apex Legends weapon variety

mechanics.name: Zero-G Movement System
mechanics.description: Players can move freely in three dimensions using magnetic boots and thruster packs. Wall-running, ceiling combat, and momentum preservation create dynamic movement options.
mechanics.implementation: Physics-based movement with configurable thrust values. Magnetic attachment system for surface traversal. Momentum conservation across all movement states.
mechanics.impact: Dramatically increases skill ceiling and map awareness requirements. Creates unique tactical opportunities and engagement angles.
mechanics.balance: Thruster fuel management prevents infinite movement. Magnetic boot attachment has brief delay to prevent instant direction changes.

mechanics.name: Component-Based Weapon Crafting
mechanics.description: Weapons are assembled from modular components found throughout maps. Barrels, triggers, scopes, and power sources can be combined for custom loadouts.
mechanics.implementation: Drag-and-drop interface for weapon assembly. Component stats affect weapon performance. Limited inventory slots force tactical decisions.
mechanics.impact: Every match feels unique with different weapon configurations. Encourages map exploration and resource management.
mechanics.balance: Higher-tier components are rarer and located in dangerous map positions. Assembly time creates vulnerability windows.

levels.name: Derelict Station Alpha
levels.environment: Abandoned space station with zero-g corridors, rotating gravity sections, and exposed hull areas. Industrial machinery provides cover and movement opportunities.
levels.enemies: Environmental hazards include radiation zones, explosive machinery, and depressurizing chambers.
levels.rewards: High-tier weapon components spawn in the central reactor chamber every 3 minutes.
levels.notes: Asymmetric spawn positions despite symmetrical layout. Central area favors long-range engagements while outer corridors suit close combat.

characters.name: Assault Marine
characters.abilities: Enhanced thruster capacity for extended zero-g maneuvering. Quick weapon swap speed.
characters.background: Former military personnel adapted for void combat operations. Standard issue equipment optimized for versatility.
characters.visual: Bulky power armor with visible thruster arrays. Battle-worn plating with unit insignias. Glowing visor HUD display.
characters.behavior: Player-controlled character class. AI bots use medium-range engagement tactics.
characters.strengths: Balanced stats make them viable in all situations. Extended movement capability.
characters.weaknesses: No specialized advantages. Moderate health pool requires tactical positioning.

items.name: Plasma Rifle
items.description: Standard-issue plasma weapon firing superheated energy bolts. Reliable damage output with moderate rate of fire.
items.purpose: Versatile medium-range combat weapon suitable for most engagement scenarios.
items.mechanism: Draws power from weapon's energy cell. Overheating mechanism prevents sustained fire beyond 8 shots.
items.visual: Angular design with glowing blue energy chamber. Visible power indicator on the side. Steam vents when cooling.
items.acquisition: Found throughout maps, craft using common components, starting loadout option.
items.balance: Balanced damage-to-rate ratio. Projectile travel time requires leading targets at long range.

items.name: Thruster Fuel Canister
items.description: Pressurized fuel canister that completely refills thruster capacity for extended zero-g movement.
items.purpose: Enables extended movement sequences and quick escapes from dangerous situations.
items.mechanism: Instant thruster refuel when consumed. Cannot be used while thrusters are active.
items.visual: Small cylindrical canister with warning labels. Glowing fuel level indicator.
items.acquisition: Found near thruster maintenance bays, random loot spawn, crafted using rare components.
items.balance: Limited spawn locations force players into contested areas. Consumption time creates vulnerability window.

audio.name: Plasma Rifle Fire
audio.context: Triggered when player fires plasma rifle
audio.description: Sharp electric crack followed by a brief energy hum. Distinct enough to identify weapon type from audio alone.
audio.implementation: 3D positional audio with distance falloff. Slight pitch variation to prevent repetition fatigue.

art_style.name: Environmental Lighting
art_style.colors: Deep blues, stark oranges, metallic grays with rust accents
art_style.description: Harsh industrial lighting creates dramatic shadows and highlights. Emergency lighting provides color contrast against dark metal surfaces.
art_style.mood: Oppressive, dangerous, technologically advanced but deteriorating
art_style.technical: Real-time ray-traced reflections on metal surfaces. Volumetric lighting for atmosphere.
art_style.references: Alien franchise industrial aesthetic, Warhammer 40K gothic technology, Dead Space lighting design

technical.name: Networking Architecture
technical.requirements: Broadband internet, stable connection for competitive play
technical.description: Authoritative server architecture with client-side prediction for movement. Anti-cheat integration and lag compensation systems.
technical.implementation: Custom UDP protocol with reliability layer. Delta compression for bandwidth efficiency. Server-side hit validation.
technical.challenges: Zero-g movement creates complex prediction scenarios. High-speed projectiles require precise timing synchronization.
technical.testing: Automated latency testing across regions. Load testing for 64-player scenarios. Cheat detection validation.
